#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int r;
    while (b > 0) {
        r = a % b;
        a = b;
        b = r;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    int g = gcd(x, y);
    x /= g;
    y /= g;

    if (n >= y) {
        cout << x << "/" << y << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    long double target = (long double)x / y;
    long double bestError = target;
    vector<int> ans(n, 0);
    int bestDen = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        long double h = i * target;
        long double low = floor(h);
        long double errLow = fabs(low / i - target);
        long double errHigh = fabs((low + 1) / i - target);

        if (bestError > errLow || bestError > errHigh) {
            if (errLow > errHigh) {
                ans[i - 1] = (int)low + 1;
                bestDen = i;
                bestError = errHigh;
            } else {
                ans[i - 1] = (int)low;
                bestDen = i;
                bestError = errLow;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << ans[bestDen - 1] << "/" << bestDen;
    return 0;
}
